name: hermes-test-gate
description: Hermes 웹훅으로 받은 PR의 QA 테스트 기록을 Claude Code가 평가하는 하위 프로젝트 (가제: testgate)

scripts.mock:safe: pnpm mock:plain && pnpm mock:other-author && pnpm mock:edited && pnpm mock:issue && pnpm mock:bad-signature
scripts.mock:dry: for c in qa qa-commit qa-multiline qa-design qa-empty qa-free qa-free-commit plain other-author edited issue; do MOCK_DRY_RUN=1 scripts/mock_post.sh $c; done
scripts.test: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t . && python3 scripts/test_qa_filter.py
scripts.gateway:restart:systemd: systemctl --user restart hermes-gateway && systemctl --user is-active hermes-gateway
